title: Blueprint
description: Contract 1. The typed, versioned description of one tenant's business: entities, workflows, roles, approvals, reports, integrations, compliance, i18n, branding. The Blueprint is configuration, never code. Cross-reference rules that JSON Schema cannot express (ids resolve, locales covered, contrast passes) are enforced by the Blueprint validator in Part 2 and listed in x-validator-rules.

locations.description: Branches and warehouses. Referenced by role scopes.

components.description: Components this tenant uses, with version ranges. Entity bindings must reference ids listed here. Resolved to exact versions at compile time.

reports.description: Reports and dashboards. They reference metrics from the semantic layer by id; they never contain SQL or formulas.

assistants.description: Optional (Blueprint 0.3.0; transition allowlist 0.4.0; ADR-0043). Department-scoped chat assistants: configuration of the one chat per department. An assistant has no identity or authority of its own; it acts only with the invoking user's role and scope.

x-rigid-zone-terms.description: Rigid zone (AGENTS.md principle 3). A module setting key, or a field id on an entity bound by a module concept, that holds one of these substrings, or a camelCase or snake_case token starting with one of these tokens, is a formula, posting, costing, tax, payroll, pricing or amount knob. Those stay engine or certified-component logic; the Blueprint never declares them. Used by contracts/tests/test_blueprint_modules.py and the validator rule BP-MOD-001.

x-validator-rules: company.locale fields are optional; each omitted field resolves from compliance.countryPack. The resolved locale is stored with the compiled artifact. workingHours.periods must not overlap and weekend days must not appear in workDays.
compliance.country must equal company.country and the countryPack id must match the country.
Every id is unique within its collection and every reference (entity, role, approval, report, component, location, metric, connector) resolves.
Every localizedText covers every locale in meta.locales.
Workflow graph: exactly one initial state per workflow, every state reachable, every non-final state has an outgoing transition.
Approval rule steps reference existing roles; a role cannot approve its own submission unless selfApproval is true and the owner role holds it.
A role scope dimension must exist in locations or be 'own_records' or 'company'.
Entity component bindings reference components listed in components and satisfy the manifest's requires and engine compatibility.
Fields with computed.function may only reference functions provided by a bound component (numbers come from code).
Branding: primary and accent colours pass WCAG AA against the surfaces of BOTH themes after token resolution (see docs/architecture/theming.md); otherwise auto-adjust or reject.
Branding assets: media type, size and sanitisation fields match the stored asset record.
branding.poweredBy.show=false requires the white-label entitlement on the tenant plan.
Compliance: when compliance.eInvoicing.mode is not 'none' for country SA, documentLanguages must contain 'ar' and company.vatNumber must be set.

Assistants (ADR-0043): roles resolve and belong to the department (or are owner or general manager); the department has at least one role; tools are in the tenant's generated tool set, agent-creatable, at most R2, and every R2 tool has confirm=true; at least one invoking role may call each tool; never approve, reject, submit, cancel, amend or delete verbs, approval.decide, blueprint tools, protected bank, contact or access tools, or writes other than create, update and export on ledger- or stock-class entities, with or without a tool set; a transition tool lists its allowed transitions, none an approve, reject or reversal move or one with its own approval rule; no tool is listed twice; memory tools need a memory scope; limits are within platform and plan caps; the instructions key resolves.

Modules (ADR-0079): a module is on for this company only when its key is present. Its component is listed in components and provides the capability <module>.module; every concept entity resolves and has an implements binding to a component providing <module>.<concept>; every module role resolves and holds read on each required concept entity (listing a role grants nothing). A report metric whose id starts with a module prefix (crm., projects., manufacturing., marketing.) needs that module on and must be in the module's metric list in contracts/blueprint-modules.md.
CRM (ADR-0079): pipeline stage ids are unique and the order is the pipeline order; open stages have strictly increasing probabilityPercent; leadSources and lostReasons ids are unique.

Projects (ADR-0079): task status and view ids are unique; every board column lists task status ids and each status sits in exactly one column of a board; timeline and calendar fields are date or datetime fields of the view's concept entity (BP-MOD-002); visibleToRoles resolve and hold read on that entity. timesheets.invoicingComponent is listed in components and, when the registry is known, is a rigid (certified) component (BP-MOD-003).

Manufacturing (ADR-0079): warehouses reference locations of kind warehouse, workInProgress differs from finishedGoods and scrap differs from both (BP-MOD-004); the warehouse-to-account link is set only by the certified component, never by the Blueprint; the work order, job card and subcontracting receipt transitions that move stock are stock-class (ADR-0037) and their submits keep the human floor (ADR-0027). Valuation, BOM costing, operating cost, scrap value and every posting are engine or certified-component logic: no Blueprint field may set them, neither in this module object nor as a field on item, bom or any other manufacturing-bound entity (valuation_rate, rm_cost_as_per, operating_cost and the like; BP-MOD-001).

Marketing (ADR-0079): entities.campaign equals modules.crm.entities.campaign when both are set; a segment's audience concept is bound in modules.crm.entities (lead, contact, customer) and its filter fields exist on that entity; segment ids are unique. channels.messaging.integration resolves to an integration whose connector is in x-messaging-connectors (BP-MOD-005). A marketing send goes only to a contact with a granted consent for that contact, channel, country and purpose marketing (DSC-022 section 6, MSG-005) and carries an unsubscribe route; members without a contactRef are skipped; imports and segment membership never create consent; messaging sends use approved templates only. Every marketing send or campaign is R3, origin human with a required approvalId, and never agent-creatable (DSC-022 section 3, AP-MSG-03 proposed), so no assistant may list it (assistant tools are at most R2).

Module rigid zone (ADR-0079, BP-MOD-001): no field on an entity bound by a module concept (every modules.<key>.entities value, timesheet and activity_type included) has an id matching x-rigid-zone-terms, for example billing_rate, costing_rate or amount; the bound timesheet and activity_type entities carry no money field. Rates, costs, amounts and postings are engine or certified-component fields, never mapped from the Blueprint.

modules.description: Optional (Blueprint 0.5.0, ADR-0079). Engine-core modules this company opts into. A module is on when its key is present; absent means off. Each module binds its concept vocabulary to Blueprint entities and roles and names the component that implements it; settings carry configuration only, never formulas, posting or valuation logic.

moduleRoles.description: Module role vocabulary. manage: the roles that the module's screens treat as managers; work: the roles they treat as workers; view: the roles they treat as viewers. Listing grants nothing: roles[].permissions and scope decide everything.

crmModule.description: CRM on the engine's core CRM records only (ADR-0076 item 5): leads, opportunities, customers, contacts, activities and the campaign link. Never the separate CRM app.

stages.description: Opportunity stages in pipeline order. At least one open stage, exactly one won and exactly one lost stage. An open stage has probabilityPercent strictly between 0 and 100.

probabilityPercent.description: Owner's estimate for weighted pipeline metrics; the metric itself is computed by code.

activityTypes.description: Activity kinds offered on leads and opportunities. message is sent only through a messaging connector integration.

campaignLink.description: Leads and opportunities carry a campaign link. Needs entities.campaign.

projectsModule.description: Projects and boards (Blueprint 0.6.0) over the engine's core projects, tasks and timesheets. Board, timeline and calendar are view declarations over the same task records, not separate data.

taskStatuses.description: The company's task statuses in order, each mapped to one engine task status. Overdue is derived by the engine from the end date and is never mapped.

billable.description: Hours may be billed through a sales invoice. Needs enabled true and invoicingComponent. Rates and invoice amounts come from the engine and the certified invoicing component, never from the Blueprint.

invoicingComponent.description: The certified invoicing component that bills the hours. Required when billable is true.

concept.description: Which module concept the view shows.

visibleToRoles.description: Rows are still limited by each viewer's scope.

columns.description: Columns in order. Moving a card to a column sets the card's task status to the column's first status.

manufacturingModule.description: Manufacturing (Blueprint 0.7.0) on the engine's core BOM, work order, job card, routing and subcontracting records. Rigid-zone boundary: stock movements and their value post through deterministic engine logic; this object only selects which records and steps are used.

entities.description: Concept to Blueprint entity id. item is the inventory item master shared with stock.

multiLevel.description: Sub-assemblies may have their own BOM.

enabled.description: Operations, workstations and routings are used.

jobCards.description: Each work order operation gets a job card for time and quantity.

materialTransfer.description: Raw materials move to work in progress against the work order, or per job card (needs job cards).

batchFromWorkOrder.description: Finished goods batches are created from the work order for batch-tracked items.

warehouses.description: Inventory touch points: location ids of kind warehouse; workInProgress, finishedGoods and scrap are three different warehouses. Each warehouse's ledger account is set only by the certified component.

marketingModule.description: Marketing (Blueprint 0.8.0): segments, campaigns, email campaigns on the engine's core records, and messaging campaigns sent only through the messaging connector (DSC-022). Consent is not optional.

entities.description: Concept to Blueprint entity id. campaign is shared with the CRM campaign link.

segments.description: Saved audiences. Filters are guards over the audience entity (AND); no free text query.

audience.description: CRM concept the segment selects from. Consent and sends are keyed by contact (DSC-022 contactRef): a lead or customer member without a contact is skipped at send.

visibleToRoles.description: Roles that see the segment. An empty list means nobody.

consent.description: PDPL and channel rules. The consent records themselves are tenant data kept per DSC-022 section 6, never in the Blueprint; imports and segment membership never create consent.

optInRequired.description: A marketing send goes only to a contact with a granted consent for that contact, channel, country and purpose marketing (DSC-022 section 6; refused as MSG-005 otherwise). A utility-purpose consent never covers a marketing send.

unsubscribeRoute.description: Every message carries a way to opt out, honoured before the next send.

channels.description: At least one channel is enabled while the module is on.

integration.description: Integration id whose connector is a DSC-022 messaging connector (x-messaging-connectors: msg.meta_whatsapp, msg.meta_instagram, msg.meta_messenger, msg.sms).

templatesOnly.description: Marketing messages use provider-approved templates only.

assistant.description: ADR-0043. One department assistant. It never carries a role, scope, grant, approver or service identity: every call runs with the invoking user's own permissions, intersected with this tool list.

department.description: The department, named by the role function that works in it (docs/product/app-screens.md department views).

roles.description: Role ids whose users may invoke this assistant. Being listed grants nothing: the user's own permissions still decide every call.

instructionsKey.description: i18n key of the instruction text, never inline prose. Resolved from the platform catalog (L0) or i18n.labelOverrides (tenant text, L1, slot text only: tone and terminology, never tools, roles, limits or approvals).

tool.description: Tool API name from the tenant's generated tool set.

confirm.description: The user confirms each call over the rendered payload. Required true for R2 tools.

transitions.description: Blueprint 0.4.0. Required on, and only allowed on, <entity>.transition tools: the transition ids this assistant may make. Never an approve, reject or reversal move; each must be agent-creatable and at most R2.

limits.description: Caps per user. The schema maxima are the platform caps; plan caps may be lower. They only restrict.

perCall.description: One invocation: one user request and the tool calls it leads to.

scope.description: none: nothing kept; session: the user's current thread only; department: notes shared inside this tenant and department, read back as L3 and filtered by the reader's scope. Never cross-tenant.

id.description: snake_case identifier, stable for the life of the element.

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, for example ar, ar-SA, en.

localizedText.description: Text per locale. ar and en are mandatory in v0.1.0.

provenance.description: Where an element came from. The Platform Autonomy Rate is the share of elements whose source is not 'manual' and whose humanEdited is false at go-live.

ref.description: Template id and version, interview turn id, or import job id. Empty for manual.

humanEdited.description: True when a person (owner or team reviewer) changed the element after the AI produced it.

editedBy.description: Who made the last human edit. Absent when humanEdited is false.

revision.description: Increments on every approved change. Diffs are between revisions.

buildState.description: See contracts/build-states.md. Stored here for convenience; the control plane is the source of truth.

versionSet.description: Pinned engine version set id, for example 'set-2026-a'.

country.description: Operating countries are SA, AE, EG and QA (no fixed launch order). Others are reserved.

crNumber.description: Commercial registration number (KSA format: 10 digits). Optional until compliance needs it. UNVERIFIED for other countries; the country pack may relax the pattern.

vatNumber.description: VAT registration number or UAE TRN, 15 digits. Optional until VAT registered.

companyLocale.description: Per-company calendar, week, hours, fiscal year, numbers and currency. Every field is optional; omitted fields take the country pack default. Dates are stored as Gregorian ISO/UTC regardless of these settings (docs/architecture/calendars-and-locale.md).

timezone.description: IANA zone, for example Asia/Riyadh, Asia/Dubai, Africa/Cairo.

secondaryDisplay.description: Shown beside the primary date in lists and on documents where layout allows.

reducedPeriods.description: Periods with different hours, for example Ramadan. Start can be a fixed date or tied to a Hijri event so it moves each year.

id.description: For example sa.holidays, supplied by the country pack.

overrides.description: Admin overrides: add a company day off, remove a pack holiday, or move one (for example when an authority announces a different date).

numberSystem.description: Digit shapes in the UI. Documents may differ where law or the customer requires.

parameters.description: Values for the parameters declared in the component manifest, validated against it.

componentId.description: Dotted id, for example core.sales_invoice or compliance.zatca_sa.

components.description: Component bindings: which certified components implement this entity (rigid) or extend it (configurable).

target.description: For type link: the target entity id.

precision.description: Decimal places for decimal, money, percent.

computed.description: Value produced by deterministic code from a bound component. The Blueprint names the function; it never contains a formula.

visibleToRoles.description: Empty or absent means every role with read access to the entity.

field.description: Field id on the entity, or a related field as relation.field.

approval.description: Approval rule id that must be satisfied before the transition completes.

kind.description: Optional explicit transition kind (ADR-0037). The Tool API generator uses it in place of its structural rule for stock and ledger entities; name tokens in the transition id still only add restriction and the riskiest candidate wins, so a declared kind never lowers risk. Absent: the generator infers the kind (contracts/tool-api.md section 11).

values.description: Location ids for branch, warehouse or department scopes. Absent for company, own_records and assigned_records.

reports.description: Report or dashboard ids shown on the role's home view.

quickActions.description: Workflow transition ids offered as one-tap actions.

canUseChatActions.description: Whether the chat may act for this role. Chat always acts with the user's own permissions; this can only restrict.

isAdmin.description: May change branding and request Blueprint changes. At least one role must be admin.

conditions.description: Rule applies only when all hold, for example amount above a threshold.

ref.description: Semantic-layer metric id, for example sales.revenue.

visibleToRoles.description: Rows are still limited by each viewer's scope.

connector.description: Connector id from the connector registry.

source.description: Path in the normalised source model.

country.description: Operating countries are SA, AE, EG and QA (no fixed launch order). Others are reserved.

countryPack.description: The certified Country Pack (tax, e-invoicing, holiday calendar, work week, payroll rules, document templates, formats) this tenant runs on. Supplies defaults for every omitted company.locale field. See docs/architecture/country-packs.md.

mode.description: UAE and Egypt values are placeholders until those regimes are confirmed (UNVERIFIED); see docs/research/03-regulations.md.

hijriDisplay.description: Legacy switch for dual-date display on documents; detailed calendar choices live in company.locale.

socialInsurance.description: UNVERIFIED mapping; payroll is not v1 scope.

glossary.description: Tenant terms that the AI and UI must use consistently, seeded from docs/glossary.md.

labelOverrides.description: Map of i18n key to localizedText, for tenant renames of standard labels.

assetRef.description: Reference to an uploaded brand asset. The file lives in per-tenant storage; see docs/architecture/theming.md. The asset record, not the client, is authoritative for the fields below.

sanitised.description: Set by the asset pipeline after SVG sanitisation (scripts and external references stripped) and malware scan. Blueprints referencing unsanitised assets are rejected.

branding.description: Tenant workspace branding. Changeable only by roles with isAdmin, previewed before apply, versioned with the Blueprint, audited. Token layering: docs/architecture/theming.md.

onDark.description: Logo for dark surfaces. Omit and set deriveDark to derive one.

deriveDark.description: Derive a dark-surface variant from onLight when onDark is absent.

primaryColour.description: Subject to WCAG AA checks in both themes; may be auto-adjusted. Status colours and typography are not brandable.

source.description: auto generates the required sizes (16, 32, 48, 180, 192, 512) from the logo.

documentHeader.description: Options for tenant-branded documents. Legally required layout and content always win over these options.

logoPosition.description: start/end are logical positions and flip in RTL.

accentOnDocuments.description: Use the primary colour for table headers on documents. Never applies to legally mandated elements.

show.description: Show the platform mark in app chrome. false requires the white-label entitlement.
